issues_in: URL accessibility: https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/alabama-city-considers-data-center-moratorium-could-kill-edged-project/ returned HTTP 403 from this review environment
fixed: Retried the DCD URL (HEAD + GET with browser UA): both returned HTTP 403, confirming the review finding.

Replaced the 403 DCD URL in data.json sources[0] with the verified idcnova.com article (2026-08-11, HTTP 200) covering the same moratorium/Project Gateway story (8 MW, $93M, 214 Telegraph Road, former 911 data-center site, late-2026 groundbreaking target).
Added mynbc15.com local NBC15 coverage (2026-06-11, HTTP 200) to sources to corroborate the networking-hub, former-911-site, and late-2026-groundbreaking facts previously attributed to DCD.
Updated contradictions[0].notes attribution from 'DCD report' to '2026-08-11 industry reporting (idcnova.com)' for consistency with the source list.
Added a data.json history entry (field 'sources', date 2026-08-11) documenting the swap with previous/current values and reason.
Added a NOTES.md 2026-08-11 bullet documenting the swap with both URLs and the 403 reason; the original DCD URL is retained in NOTES.md and the history entry for reference (no deletion).
Validated data.json parses as JSON (json.load OK).
remaining_risks: The DCD page is likely live for human browsers (403 is anti-bot behavior rather than content removal); it is retained only in NOTES.md/history, no longer in sources.

idcnova.com is an industry aggregator, not an official/local-government source; no accessible official City of Prichard agenda/minutes source exists to replace it (pre-existing gap, unchanged by this fix).
Replacement URLs verified by curl HEAD/GET (both 200) and article content by web browse on 2026-08-11; no deep fact re-verification of the full entry was performed.
summary: Fixed the single review issue for disc026: the DatacenterDynamics URL returning HTTP 403 was replaced in data.json sources with a verified idcnova.com article covering the same Prichard moratorium/Project Gateway story, plus mynbc15.com local coverage added to corroborate the networking-hub and former-911-site facts. The swap is documented in data.json history and NOTES.md, and data.json validates as JSON.
